title: Self-information
summary: A less probable event carries more self-information under a logarithmic coding model.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared information theory context is fixed.

content.plain: A less probable event carries more self-information under a logarithmic coding model.
content.exact: For event E with 0<P(E)≤1, I(E)=−log_b P(E); the base b fixes units such as bits when b=2.
content.example: A fair coin result carries 1 bit of self-information.
content.caveat: This technical quantity is not identical to meaning, knowledge, usefulness, or truth.
